counter_semantics.stage_wall: Existing StageMetric spans; compilation and setup appear on first use.
counter_semantics.stage_kernel_sync: Legacy field: NPUChain includes copies/sync; do not add to wall time.
counter_semantics.low_level: Timed original pyxrt sync/start/wait2 and numpy.copyto calls via AST wrappers; includes their Python crossing overhead.
counter_semantics.sync_bytes: Exact BO size per sync, cache-maintenance exposure, not discrete-device bus traffic.
counter_semantics.capture: Contains tensor capture/comparison overhead; excluded from performance samples.
counter_semantics.timing: Direct ComfyUI sampler, warm conditioning, VAE decode separate; not browser/API prompt wall.

methodology.control: This checkout, QKV chaining, 19 dispatches per block; not the separately installed optimized production runtime.
methodology.oracle: Existing BF16 CPU 28-block chain, independently evaluated on each baseline sampler input; not a stock-FP32 CPU sampler.
methodology.timing: Three warm samples per variant, order rotated by repeat. Sampler only; text loading/encoding, compilation, tensor capture/comparison, and VAE decoding excluded.
methodology.stage_accounting: Stage spans cover their own allocations and operations, not the entire block/sampler lifetime. Representative profile is the run with median sampler wall time. Nested XRT/copy counters are not additive to stage wall.
methodology.accuracy: NRMS is L2(actual-reference)/L2(reference). Same-input replays isolate within-chain propagation; independent trajectories additionally include sampler feedback.
methodology.decode_recovery: All original sampler and accuracy measurements retained. PNG encoding alone was recovered in a separate CPU process after adding support for singleton-frame VAE output.
